verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox is an isolated microVM execution environment that runs code, not an agent or assistant that consumes tools. Plugging in MCP servers as an MCP client is therefore outside this product's role. Bundled coding agents in the default image are third-party software running inside the sandbox, not the product itself acting as an MCP client, and nothing in the evidence shows MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
